2607.27262.title: LLM-Guided Initialization for Accelerated Hybrid Quantum-Classical Medical Image Classification
2607.27262.paper_summary: Variational quantum algorithms often encounter barren plateaus, where cost gradients decay rapidly with increasing circuit depth, undermining the trainability of parameterized quantum circuits. This paper evaluates AdaInit (Adaptive Initialization), proposed by Zhuang and Cunningham, which uses large language models to propose initial parameters for quantum neural networks. We study a simplified single-query AdaInit variant paired with GPU-accelerated simulation in NVIDIA CUDA-Q and apply it to binary classification on the DMR-IR mammography dataset. AdaInit delivers 14.6 times higher gradient variance at initialization than random initialization (0.0095 vs. 0.0006), producing 160 times faster convergence (1.1s vs. 176 s) while maintaining the same classification accuracy of 61.4 percent. We provide theoretical analysis grounded in the geometry of parameterized circuit landscapes and show empirically that LLM-guided initialization places the optimizer in trainable regions of parameter space. Beyond performance, our results indicate that a single LLM query can yield informative parameters without iterative refinement, suggesting a low-overhead path to improved trainability. The findings validate AdaInit in a medical imaging setting and demonstrate its compatibility with GPU-accelerated quantum backends for practical speedups.
2607.27262.paper_summary_zh: 變分量子算法經常遭遇貧瘠高原，隨著電路深度的增加，成本梯度迅速衰減，這削弱了參數化量子電路的可訓練性。本文評估了由Zhuang和Cunningham提出的AdaInit（自適應初始化），該方法利用大型語言模型為量子神經網絡提出初始參數。我們研究了一種簡化的單查詢AdaInit變體，並結合NVIDIA CUDA-Q的GPU加速模擬，將其應用於DMR-IR乳腺攝影數據集的二元分類。AdaInit在初始化時提供的梯度方差比隨機初始化高出14.6倍（0.0095對0.0006），實現了160倍的更快收斂（1.1秒對176秒），同時保持61.4%的相同分類準確率。我們提供了基於參數化電路景觀幾何的理論分析，並實證顯示LLM引導的初始化將優化器置於可訓練的參數空間區域。除了性能之外，我們的結果表明，單次LLM查詢可以產生有用的參數，而無需迭代精煉，這暗示了改善可訓練性的低開銷途徑。這些發現驗證了AdaInit在醫學影像環境中的有效性，並展示了其與GPU加速量子後端的兼容性，以實現實際的加速。
